info.name: Wingspan Payments 1099 Operations Payables Management API

items.docs: This endpoint provides a comprehensive summary of all the payables, offering insights into the current state of pending and completed payments. Ideal for clients and financial departments looking for a snapshot view of their payment obligations.

info.name: Retrieve Approved Payables Ready for Immediate Payroll

items.docs: Fetches all payables that have been approved and are awaiting immediate payroll processing. This provides a quick view of all payments that are due for immediate payroll execution.

info.name: List All Payables Associated with a Client

items.docs: Provides an list of all Payables associated with a specific client, facilitating easier management and overview of the client's financial obligations.

info.name: Create a New Payable for a Member on Behalf of a Client

items.docs: Allows for the generation of a new Payables for a specific member on behalf of a client. This ensures streamlined billing and effective financial tracking between clients and members.

info.name: Retrieve Payable Details by Payable ID

items.docs: This API endpoint is designed to fetch the detailed Payable information of a member using a unique Payable ID.

info.name: Update Client Payable Information by Payable ID

items.docs: This API endpoint facilitates the updating of existing payable details related to a client using a unique Payable ID.

info.name: Delete Client Payable by Payable ID

items.docs: This API endpoint is designed to remove the payable information related to a client using a unique Payable ID.
